{"_meta":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo":{"description":"Context7 provides up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.","icons":[{"mimeType":"image/svg+xml","sizes":["any"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.svg"},{"mimeType":"image/png","sizes":["512x512"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.png"}],"name":"Context7","title":"Context7","version":"4.4.2","websiteUrl":"https://context7.com"}},"content":[{"text":"### import.meta.resolve(specifier[, parent])\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/esm.md\n\nResolves a module specifier relative to the current module or an optional parent URL. Returns the resolved absolute URL string synchronously.\n\n```APIDOC\n## import.meta.resolve(specifier[, parent])\n\n### Description\nA module-relative resolution function scoped to each module that returns the absolute URL string a specifier resolves to.\n\n### Syntax\n```js\nimport.meta.resolve(specifier[, parent])\n```\n\n### Parameters\n- **specifier** `{string}` - The module specifier to resolve relative to the current module.\n- **parent** `{string|URL}` *(Optional, requires `--experimental-import-meta-resolve`)* - An optional absolute parent module URL to resolve from. **Default:** `import.meta.url`.\n\n### Return Value\n- `{string}` - The absolute URL string that the specifier resolves to.\n\n### Example\n```js\nconst dependencyAsset = import.meta.resolve('component-lib/asset.css');\n// file:///app/node_modules/component-lib/asset.css\n\nconst localDep = import.meta.resolve('./dep.js');\n// file:///app/dep.js\n```\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Load relative files using import.meta.url\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/esm.md\n\nConstruct a file URL relative to the current ES module to load local files using standard Node.js APIs.\n\n```javascript\nimport { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nconst buffer = readFileSync(new URL('./data.proto', import.meta.url));\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Importing file URLs with queries\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/esm.md\n\nModules are loaded multiple times if their import specifier has distinct query parameters or fragments.\n\n```js\nimport './foo.mjs?query=1'; // loads ./foo.mjs with query of \"?query=1\"\nimport './foo.mjs?query=2'; // loads ./foo.mjs with query of \"?query=2\"\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### Using top-level await across modules\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/esm.md\n\nDemonstrates using top-level `await` in an exported module (`a.mjs`) and importing its resolved value in another module (`b.mjs`), then running it with Node.js.\n\n```js\nexport const five = await Promise.resolve(5);\n```\n\n```js\nimport { five } from './a.mjs';\n\nconsole.log(five); // Logs `5`\n```\n\n```bash\nnode b.mjs # works\n```\n\n### import.meta > import.meta.resolve(specifier)\n\nSource: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/esm.md\n\n> Stability: 1.2 - Release candidate\n\n* `specifier` {string} The module specifier to resolve relative to the\n  current module.\n* Returns: {string} The absolute URL string that the specifier would resolve to.\n\n[`import.meta.resolve`][] is a module-relative resolution function scoped to\neach module, returning the URL string.\n\nAll features of the Node.js module resolution are supported. Dependency\nresolutions are subject to the permitted exports resolutions within the package.\n\n**Caveats**:\n\n* This can result in synchronous file-system operations, which\n  can impact performance similarly to `require.resolve`.\n* This feature is not available within custom loaders (it would\n  create a deadlock).\n\n**Non-standard API**:\n\nWhen using the `--experimental-import-meta-resolve` flag, that function accepts\na second argument:\n\n* `parent` {string|URL} An optional absolute parent module URL to resolve from.\n  **Default:** `import.meta.url`","type":"text"}],"isError":false}
